verses.en: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;
verses.sm: Ona faalatalata mai lea o matai sili o sa Levi ia Eleasaro le faitaulaga, ma losua le atalii o Nuno, ma matai sili o itu aiga o le fanauga a Isaraelu;

verses.en: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
verses.sm: ma latou fai atu ia te i latou i Sailo i le nuu o Kanana, ua faapea atu, Na poloai mai le ALII ia Mose, ia tuuina mai ia te i matou o aai E nonofo ai, ma o latou tuafanua mo a matou manu.

verses.en: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.
verses.sm: Ona tuuina atu lea e le fanauga a Isaraelu i sa Levi, ai o latou tofi, e pei o le afioga a le ALII, o ia aai ma o latou tuāfanua.

verses.en: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
verses.sm: Ua faasaga le vili i aiga o sa Koato; o atalii foi 0 Arona le faitaulaga, e o sa Levi, na maua e i latou le tofì ai le itu aiga o Iuta, ma le itu aiga o Simeona, ma le itu aiga o Peniamina, o aai e sefulu ma le tolu.

verses.en: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.sm: O e na totoe o atalii o Koato, na maua e i latou le tofi ai aiga o le itu aiga o Efaraima, ma le itu aiga o Tanu, ma le tasi vaega o le itu aiga o Manase, o aai e sefulu.

verses.en: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.sm: Na maua foi le tofi e atalii o Keresona ai aiga o le itu aiga o Isakara, ma le itu aiga O Asera, ma le itu aiga o Nafatali, ma le tasi vaega o le itu aiga O Manase i Vasana, o aai e sefulu ma le tolu.

verses.en: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.sm: Na maua le tofi e atalii o Merari e tusa ma o latou aiga, ai le itu aiga o Reupena, ma le itu aiga o Kato, ma le itu aiga o Sepulona, o aai e sefulu ma le lua.

verses.en: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.sm: Na tofia i le vili e le fanauga a Isaraelu i sa Levi o ia aai ma o latou tuáfanua, e pei ona fetalai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
verses.sm: Ona tuuina atu lea e i latou ai le itu aiga o le fanauga a Iuta, ma le itu aiga o le fanauga a Simeona, o ia aai ua ta‘ua o latou igoa,

verses.en: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for their's was the first lot.
verses.sm: sa i ai i atalii o Arona, o i latou ua aiga ma Koato, o le fanauga a Levi, aua sa ia te i latou le tofi muamua.

verses.en: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.sm: Ua tuuina atu foi ia te i latou le aai o Arapa le tama o Anaki, o Heperona lea, i le atu mauga o Iuta, ma ona tuafanua e siosio ai.

verses.en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
verses.sm: A o fanua o le aai ma ona faoa aai, ua tuuina atu e i latou ia Kalepo le atalii o Iefune, e fai mona.

verses.en: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Ua latou tuuina atu i atalii o Arona le faitaulaga, o Heperona ma ona tuáfanua, e fai ma aai o sulufaiga mo le fasioti tagata; ma Lipena ma ona tuafanut;

verses.en: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,
verses.sm: ma latira ma ona tuāfanua; ma Esetemoa ma ona tuafanua;

verses.en: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,
verses.sm: ma Holona ma ona tuāfanua; ma Tiperi ma ona tuāfanua;

verses.en: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
verses.sm: ma Aino ma ona tuáfanua; ma [waa ma ona tuāfanua; ma Petesemesa ma ona tuafanua; o aai e iva mai ia itu aiga e lua.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Mai le itu aiga foi o Peniamina, o Kipeona ma ona tuafanua; ma Kipea ma ona tuāfanua;

verses.en: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.sm: ma Anatota ma ona tuafanua; ma Alemoni ma ona tuafanua; o aai e fa.

verses.en: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.sm: O aai uma o le au faitaulaga, o atalii o Arona, O aai e sefulu ma le tolu, ma o latou tuafanua.

verses.en: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.sm: O aiga o atalii o Koato, o sa Levi na totoe o atalii o Koato, sa i ai aai o latou tofì ai le itu aiga o Efaraima.

verses.en: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Ua latou tuuina atu ia te i latou o Sekema ma ona tuáfanua, i le mauga o Efaraima, e fai ma aa; o sulufaiga mo le fasioti tagata; ma Kasera ma ona tuāfanua;

verses.en: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.sm: ma Kipesaima ma ona tuafanua; ma Peteorana ma ona tuafanua; O aai e fa.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Mai le itu aiga o Tanu, o Eliteka ma ona tuafanua; ma Kipetonu ma ona tuafanua;

verses.en: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.sm: ma Ailona ma ona tuāfanua; ma Katarimoni ma ona tuafanua; O aai e fa.

verses.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
verses.sm: Mai le vaeluaga foi o le itu aiga o Manase, o Tanaka ma ona tuáfanua; ma Katarimoni ma ona tuafanua; o aai e lua.

verses.en: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
verses.sm: O aai uma e sefulu, ma o latou tuáfanua mo aiga o atalii o Koato o e na totoe.

verses.en: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beesh-terah with her suburbs; two cities.
verses.sm: O atalii o Keresona, o aiga o sa Levi, na latou tuuina atu i ai, ai le isi vaega o le itu aiga o Manase, o Koleni i Vasana ma ona tuáfanua, e fa: ma aai o sulufaiga mo le fasioti tagata; ma Peseteri, ma ona tuafanua; O aai e lua.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Mai le itu aiga foi o Isakara, o Kiseona ma ona tuafanua; ma Taperu ma ona tuáfanua;

verses.en: Jarmuth with her suburbs, En-gannim with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.sm: ma laremuta ma ona tuāfanua; ma Enekanima ma ona tuáfanua; o aai e fa.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Mai le itu aiga foi o Asera, o Mesala ma ona tuāfanua; ma Apetonu ma ona tuafanua;

verses.en: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.sm: ma Kelekata ma ona tuāfanua; ma Reopa ma ona tuáfanua; O aai e fa.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammoth-dor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.
verses.sm: Mai le 1tu aiga foi o Nafatali, o Katesa i Kalilaia, ma ona tuāfanua, e fai ma aai o sulufaiga mo le fasioti tagata; ma Amatatoro ma ona tuāfanua; ma Karetana ma ona tuāfanua; o aai e tolu.

verses.en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.sm: O aai uma o sa Keresona, e tusa ma O latou aiga, O aai e sefulu ma le tolu, ma o latou tuāfanua.

verses.en: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Ua tuuina atu foi i aiga o atalii o Merari, o e na totoe o sa Levi, mai le itu aiga o Sepulona, o Tokeneama ma ona tuafanua; ma Karata ma ona tuafanua;

verses.en: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.sm: O Timena ma ona tuāfanua; ma Naalali ma ona tuafanua; o aai e fa.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Mai le itu aiga foi o Reupena, o Peseri ma ona tuāfanua; ma laesa ma ona tuāfanua;

verses.en: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.sm: o Katemoti ma ona tuafanau; ma Mefata ma ona tuafanua; o aai e fa.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Mai le itu aiga foi o Kato, o Ramota i Kiliata, ma ona tuáfanua, e fai ma aai o sulufaiga mo le fasioti tagata; ma Maanaita ma ona tuāfanua;

verses.en: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.
verses.sm: 0 Hesepona ma ona tuāfanua; o lasaru ma ona tuafanua; O aai uma e fa.

verses.en: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.
verses.sm: do O aai uma o atalii o Merari, e tusa ma o latou aiga, o e na totoe i aiga o sa Levi, o lo latou tofi o aai e sefulu ma le lua.

verses.en: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
verses.sm: O aai uma o sa Levi i totonu o le tofi o le fanauga a Isaraelu, o aai ia e fagafulu ma le valu, ma o latou tuáfanua.

verses.en: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.
verses.sm: O ia aai sa taitasi ma ona tuāfanua e siosio ai; sa faapea ia aai uma lava.

verses.en: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
verses.sm: Ua foaiina atu e le ALII ia Isaraelu le nuu uma na ia tauto ai e foai atu i o latou tama, ua latou fai mo latou, ma nonofo ai.

verses.en: And the LORD gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.
verses.sm: Ona avatua lea e le ALII o le mapusaga ia te i latou i itu uma, E pei o mea uma na ia tauto ai i o latou tama; e lei tu mai i o latou luma se tagata o i latou uma e na ita ia te i latou; ua tuuina atu e le ALII o i latou uma e na ita ia i latou j o latou lima.

verses.en: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
verses.sm: E lei iuvale se upu i upu lelei uma na fetalai mai ai le ALII i le aiga o Isaraelu; ua taunuu uma lava.
